analyst.summary: Kirloskar Oil Engines is delivering strong growth (nearly 13% revenue growth and over 40% profit growth in the latest quarter) on the back of its leadership in power generation equipment, and importantly its free cash flow has turned positive after several years of a debt-funded expansion phase -- a good sign the investment cycle is starting to pay off. Debt remains elevated, which our quantitative flag has already picked up, and at nearly 55 times earnings the stock is priced for continued strong execution rather than offering a bargain.
